_provenance.air.aod.method_note: MODIS MAIAC; AOD_QA bits 8-11 mask non-best retrievals; skipped (background ring has no valid pixels (7429 observations in time_range; scale=1000.0m; buffer=10km) — ring either lands over water or over a region with persistent cloud cover / sparse satellite coverage)

_provenance.air.so2.method_note: IC §0.2 six-step pipeline; skipped (site buffer has no valid pixels (583 observations in time_range; scale=1113.2m; buffer=10km))

_provenance.nature.kba.method_note: vector distance + buffer intersection; score = max(overlap_pct/100, exp(-dist_km/10.0))

_provenance.nature.dw.method_note: DW 90-day mode composite; class fractions via frequencyHistogram; scale=18m (adaptive; native 10m; target ~1.0M px)

_provenance.nature.habitat.method_note: DW mode composite (current vs baseline 5y earlier); class-fraction deltas → natural→non-natural attribution; scale=18m (adaptive; native 10m; target ~1.0M px)

_provenance.nature.forest_loss.method_note: Hansen lossyear band; cumulative loss over the most recent 5 Hansen loss years (2019-2023) weighted by ee.Image.pixelArea(); scale=31m (native)

_provenance.nature.ndvi.method_note: MOD13Q1 NDVI ÷ 10000; IC §0.2 six-step pipeline with direction='lower_is_worse' (lower NDVI = worse); scale=250m (native)

_provenance.nature.water.method_note: DW water + flooded_vegetation pixel counts via frequencyHistogram (JRC GSW deferred per GEE §4.3); scale=18m (adaptive; native 10m; target ~1.0M px)

_provenance.nature.recovery.method_note: v1 placeholder — score=0.0 baseline; wires once engine/core/trend.py lands per-pixel NDVI improvement and natural-cover-gain attribution

_provenance.nature.regional_loss_evidenc.method_note: Hansen lossyear sum over Site_Buffer and Background_Ring across the most recent 5 loss years (years 2019-2023); reference ratio = ring_rate / buffer_rate. Reference data (M-ATTRIB-A1 / audit §9.3 v1.4): regional context only, not attribution and not in the composite.

_provenance.nature.supplier_spatial_link.method_note: Centroid of natural→non-natural DW transition pixels (baseline 5y earlier) vs supplier coordinate; geodesic offset bucketed categorically. Attributability surface (M-ATTRIB-A1) — NOT in any composite or measurement-quality score; scale=18m (adaptive; native 10m; target ~1.0M px)

_provenance.ghg.co2.method_note: monthly t C → annual t CO₂ via ×(12/n_months)·(44/12); national totals × CARMA point sources + VIIRS nightlights → 1 km grid
